# pvecli ceph

Inspect Ceph (read only).

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`status`](status.md) | Overall Ceph health, monitors, OSDs and capacity. |
| [`osd`](osd.md) | OSD tree with usage and device class. |
| [`pool`](pool.md) | Ceph pools, their replication settings and their usage. |
| [`flags`](flags.md) | Ceph OSD flags and which ones are currently set. |
| [`set`](set.md) | Set Ceph OSD flags (same as 'ceph osd set', through the API). |
| [`unset`](unset.md) | Clear Ceph OSD flags, e.g. after a cluster shutdown or reboot. |
| [`versions`](versions.md) | Ceph version of every daemon, to spot the ones left behind. |
| [`log`](log.md) | Tail of the Ceph log. |
